name: Ogma

attributes.attribute: husbands of the three land goddesses
a different hero who championed Conaire
doomed king at Da Derga's hostel

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ogma was the Irish god of eloquence. He lost his life fighting a Milesian invader. Mac Cuill and Mac Greine, his brothers, were wed to the three land goddesses. The three made a trio of parallel gods. A different Mac Cecht stood by the doomed king Conaire. At the hostel of Da Derga he slew the man who had beheaded the king, then gave the king's severed head its last drink.
